name: Hex Encode / Decode
summary: Convert text to hexadecimal bytes and decode hex back to UTF-8 text.
description: Encode plain text as hex pairs or decode hexadecimal input with optional spaces and 0x prefixes. Supports uppercase output and spaced bytes when encoding.

faqs.question: How is text encoded?
faqs.answer: Characters are converted to UTF-8 bytes, then each byte is shown as two hexadecimal digits.

faqs.question: Can I paste spaced or 0x-prefixed hex?
faqs.answer: Yes. Decode strips spaces and optional 0x prefixes before converting back to text.

faqs.question: Why does decode fail?
faqs.answer: Hex must have an even number of digits and only contain 0-9 and A-F.
